{{Quote|It must the one we want. it's got a pair of A-wings escorts!|Imperial|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
'''''Kaar''''' was a modified [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 transport]] used by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The individual we want is flying a modified YT-1300 transport that has been modified for extra speed.|Imperial briefing officer|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter" />}}
Beyond the appearance of a normal YT-1300, the transport had been modified to be fast enough to outrun [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]].

==History==
{{Quote|Quickly, Delta 1, stop that other Corellian transport|Imperial|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter" />}}
The transport was used by a Rebel Spy who decided to take shelter in a [[XQ3 Platform]] called [[AZ 77 (Venzeiia 2)|''AZ 77'']] that officially was a salvage yard near [[Venzeiia 2 Prime]]. However [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] tracked the spy to the platform with the intention of capturing him alive. Fully aware that the transport can outrun Assault Gunboats, they send a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]], equipped with a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] to hamper the ship's maneuverability and disable it. After fellow ships [[Lin (starship)|''Lin'']] and ''[[Ko]]'' were disabled, the '''Kaar''' along with two [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] from [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] left the platform and the transport attempted to make the jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]]. However, despite the Rebel escorts the transport was disabled by the TIE Defender and a [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport]] arrived to board and capture the freighter to be brought back for "processing". The platform was seized shortly afterwards for harboring criminals and fugitives by forces lead by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] in his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Glory (Imperial-class)|''Glory'']].

==Legacy==
The events surrounding the '''Kaar''' and its capture, along with the platform were recorded and recreated for the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]]. [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] was one of those who took the training mission to learn how to utilize the tractor beam.
